description: Increases daycare capacity at 727 and 803 Hart Road to 70 children.
Adds commercial schools, independent schools, medical clinics as permitted uses.
Removes parking stall count; requires accessible, loading, bicycle parking.

chips.text: Approved
Public raised concerns about traffic, reduced parking, and daycare drop-off capacity.
Camponi Housing serves Métis and Indigenous families with affordable housing and supports.

description: Amends Rosewood Concept Plan, rezoning parcels near Mark Bend.
Changes land use from single-family to multi-family housing.

chips.text: Approved
Administration stated population projections are based on current standards and are always watched.
Rosewood community population will increase by nine people from three new units.
Seven individuals raised concerns about increased density, parking, traffic, and school capacity.

description: Rezones 455 Lewin Way, Stonebridge to Corridor Residential 2.
Permits ground-oriented residential and discretionary commercial uses.
Proposed development would have fewer units than current zoning.

chips.text: Approved
Staff explained CR2 facilitates a specific dwelling group product.
Greater Saskatoon Catholic Schools face over-capacity in Stonebridge.
One resident raised concerns about parking, safety, and over-development.
Staff are reviewing how to project neighborhood population for school planning.

description: Rezone 13 properties in five neighbourhoods to mixed-use districts.
Allows multi-unit residential or mixed-use buildings 8-20 meters tall.

chips.text: Approved
Owners of 1-2 unit dwellings on rezoned properties will have non-conforming uses.
Question raised about including urban forestry in the development review process.
Public expressed concerns about increased density, parking, and commercial aspects.

description: Permits underground construction into required yards for multi-unit dwellings.
Rectifies previous restrictions on underground parking for new developments.

chips.text: Approved
Councillor Jordan noted the previous restriction was an accidental over-restriction.
Home Builders Association supported the amendment to ease restrictions.
Two public inquiries supported the amendment to encourage multi-unit development.
The amendment formalizes review by Urban Forestry for sites with city trees.
City will pilot a program to formally review development applications impacting city trees.

description: Approved land use map amendment and rezoning at 1701 Attridge Drive North.
Motion to deny application defeated on tie vote.

chips.text: Received as information
Property owner at 1701 Attridge Drive North affected by approvals.
Eleven speakers addressed council regarding an application.
